scope: Material-specific, albedo-only beech-log atlas study. No runtime binding, native material, game or final-art approval.

target.normal_companion_status: Open; no normal is generated by this recipe.

sources.decode: RGB bytes without rescaling or color transformation
RGB bytes without rescaling or color transformation

reproduction.numeric_domain: IEEE 754 float64 arithmetic on encoded RGB byte values; fitting does not linearize color. Intermediate side values remain float64 until final quantization.
reproduction.output_safety: Source hashes and dimensions are checked before fitting. Existing output files and linked input/output paths are rejected. The expected source PNG hash is checked after encoding.

operations.name: side-edge-blend
operations.formula: For row y and channel c, E(y,c)=(mean(S(y,0:48,c))+mean(S(y,976:1024,c)))/2, computed from the original owned source before any mutation. For i=0..47, w(i)=(1-i/47)^2; S(y,i,c)=(1-w)*S(y,i,c)+w*E; S(y,1023-i,c)=(1-w)*S(y,1023-i,c)+w*E. Every other source pixel is unchanged.
operations.endpoint: The leftmost and rightmost source columns become the same row-wise E value.

operations.name: exact-side-coordinate-sampling
operations.pixel_centers: For zero-based output column j and row k, u=(j+0.5)/1024 and v=1-(k+0.5)/1024.
operations.coordinate_formula: su=((u-u_min)/(u_max-u_min)) modulo 1, in [0,1); sv=clamp((v_max-v)/(v_max-v_min),0,1). x=1023*su; y=1023*sv.
operations.bilinear_formula: x0=floor(x); y0=floor(y); x1=min(x0+1,1023); y1=min(y0+1,1023); fx=x-x0; fy=y-y0. C=((S[y0,x0]*(1-fx)+S[y0,x1]*fx)*(1-fy)+(S[y1,x0]*(1-fx)+S[y1,x1]*fx)*fy). Evaluation order follows the referenced implementation.
operations.coverage: Evaluate this mapping at every output pixel, including padding outside the used side UV rectangle.
operations.quantization: Round each float64 RGB value to the nearest integer with ties to even, then cast to uint8. Convex interpolation keeps the values within 0..255.

operations.name: owned-endgrain-fit

saturation.definition: Use ImageEnhance.Color(...).enhance(0.72) from the pinned image library: blend its RGB grayscale conversion with the original RGB source.

resize.definition: Pinned image-library Lanczos resampling with its three-lobe kernel, downsampling support and 8-bit output quantization.

operations.composition: Convert the sampled side background to RGBA with alpha 255, then copy the RGB endgrain image into each rectangle. Both end patches remain fully opaque.

operations.name: padding-and-channel-policy
operations.side_padding: Periodic source U and clamped source V fill the complete background. No transparent or original-image gutter is introduced.
operations.end_padding: Each 148px endgrain rectangle covers its complete end UV island plus the measured one-texel margin at 1024px. Pixels in each gutter are owned endgrain RGB.
operations.atlas_periodicity: The complete atlas is not tileable. Do not apply the generic whole-image periodic fitting option.

encoding.metadata: No inherited text, EXIF, provenance, ICC or other ancillary chunks. Source parents have no color-profile chunks; numeric RGB interpretation is retained.
encoding.encoder: Pillow 12.3.0 with zlib 1.3.2; exact compressed bytes are checked against the output hash.

balanced_derivative.preview_encoding: Same optimized PNG encoder as the source. This preview is a verification derivative; both prototype entries use the single 1024px source atlas.

limitations: The inherited convex, pointed and beveled end geometry remains unchanged.
Both original prefab scales use the same UVs, changing longitudinal detail density.
A conservative endgrain-patch sampling margin reaches the bark side at 16px. The 1px tail contains both side and end colors.
Companion normals, native shader execution, fractional LOD, material response, physics and in-game acceptance remain open.
